purpose: Coordinate a generic record viewing and editing session with an independent draft, asynchronous save/delete and explicit version conflicts.
behaviorProvider: Native React composition with existing shared Aegis controls; see explicit component and host responsibilities.

requirements.statement: Create drafts through the supplied createDraft function and use isEqual to identify dirty state. Cancel/discard exits editing without mutating the supplied record.
Preserve the current draft when the incoming record version changes during editing. Block saving until the user explicitly confirms loading the newest snapshot.
Change version for every authoritative record change and enforce expectedVersion atomically at persistence. A matching client version alone cannot prevent server races.

Pass recordId, expectedVersion and AbortSignal to onSave; accept its authoritative record/version result, or retain the draft and show rejection text. Reject a result when a different newer incoming version arrived during the save.
Use one native edit form, call reportValidity before saving, and wrap fields in a native disabled fieldset during pending or disabled state. Supply the same disabled state to renderFields.

Return independent drafts, a reliable equality comparator and individually named field controls. Explicitly disable portaled/custom controls using renderFields.disabled and provide domain validation before accepting a save.

Capture the version when deletion is requested. Reject confirmation if that version changed; await onDelete before showing deleted state and calling onDeleted. A deletion failure stays in ConfirmDialog.
Prevent overlapping save/delete operations with an operation ref; abort the current signal on unmount. Changing recordId remounts the session and intentionally discards its local draft.
Honor AbortSignal when possible and guard record identity changes with a navigation policy. Aborting client observation does not undo an already committed server mutation.
Compose ConfirmDialog and UnsavedChangesBar without restyling them. Owned structure uses workflow tokens; nested controls retain their groups.

limitations: No backend, authorization, autosave, undo, merge algorithm or automatic router guard.
The host must enforce optimistic concurrency on the server or other authoritative persistence boundary.
Record identity changes intentionally reset the session; same-version record changes violate the host version contract.
Native fieldset disabling does not disable portaled controls; renderFields.disabled is provided for that boundary.
